metrics.composite: official: tamu25.metrics with evaluate.py weights 0.30 nDCG@10 + 0.30 AP@20 + 0.25 R@30 + 0.15 P@10, unjudged products count as relevance 0
metrics.judged_only: same composite after removing unjudged products from the depth-30 list (no refill); total relevant unchanged
metrics.unjudged_top10: per query, fraction of the top 10 with no label for that query (any relevance, including 0, counts as judged); averaged over queries

tuning.criterion: mean official composite on the 4 training folds; first in (model, weight) order wins ties
